newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue 40 bln yuan of 3-yr state debt.
newsitem.headline: China to issue 40 bln yuan of 3-yr state debt.

text.p: China will issue 40 billion yuan ($4.8 billion) worth of three-year treasury bonds next month, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.
The issue, the third this year, is scheduled for May 1-31, the ministry said in a statement carried by the official Xinhua news agency.
The three-year tradeable bonds will carry an annual coupon rate of 9.18 percent and will be in 100-yuan, 1,000-yuan, and 5,000-yuan amounts, the ministry said.
They can be traded immediately after the issue closes, it said.
